# zig for cargo-zigbuild in CI and release builds, installed with
# `pip install --require-hashes -r`. Renovate (pip_requirements manager) bumps
# the version and rewrites the hashes: it writes the hashes PyPI lists for all
# files of the release, and pip accepts a file that matches any of them. Done
# by hand, take them from the PyPI page of the release (or `hashin`). Keep
# docs/development.md ("Building the image") in step.
